releases.name: Pile Plan Studio v0.1.3-alpha
changes: Import pile plans from the new standard Excel/CSV table format.
Apply pile assignments and CPT selections independently.
Preview matches, conflicts, skipped rows, and coordinate fallbacks before importing.
Improved RFEM import compatibility, including alternate worksheet names and legacy column variants.
Refined OpenAEC styling and import icon alignment.
